title: Matthew 11:28-30 — take My yoke upon you and find rest for your souls
summary: Matthew 11:28-30 in English with Me, I, My in red and the word yoke in brown. Jesus invites all who are weary and heavy-laden to come to Him, take His yoke, and learn from Him; the line 'YOU WILL FIND REST FOR YOUR SOULS' is capitalised and underlined, and the passage ends 'My yoke is easy and My burden is light.'

text.text: 28 “Come to Me, all who are weary and heavy-laden, and I will give you rest.
29 “Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and YOU WILL FIND REST FOR YOUR SOULS.
30 “For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”

keywords: Come to Me all who are weary
